description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

iCatalyst, Inc. is seeking a Jr. Software Developer to support a federal program developing an advanced analytics web application for aviation safety. The role involves building and maintaining web applications, processing data, supporting secure software delivery, and collaborating with development teams and stakeholders.
Jr. Software Developer building Java Spring Boot and Angular aviation-safety analytics applications, integrating databases and maintaining AWS CI/CD pipelines

Responsibilities:
• The successful candidate will use their enthusiasm and experience to provide support services and be an integral part of a team to facilitate the development of an advanced analytics web application to support aviation safety
• Develop and maintain Java Spring Boot + Angular web application
• Process data from both relational and graph databases
• Follow coding and development best practices to write clean understandable code
• Work as a supportive member of a development team
• Develop applications by integrating COTS products, custom code and open source, in an AWS environment
• Write code using Java, Python, Typescript (Angular), etc
• Create routines for data integration and data transfer using Postgres
• Work with both unstructured and semi-structured databases (AWS OpenSearch)
• Ability to debug and trace multi-layered applications with version control and release management
• Use JIRA or similar tools to track enhancements, bugs and implement fixes and other change requests as needed
• Researching, designing, implementing, testing, and managing software
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines leveraging GitHub Actions
• Ensure solutions follow secure coding practices and align with applicable enterprise security guidelines (e.g., NIST, FedRAMP awareness)
• Brief internal and external stakeholders on technical progress, risks, and alternative courses of action through mediums such as presentations, documents, and discussions
• Undertake special projects as required
• Provide support and expertise in assigned domain
• Write clean, efficient and complex algorithms and code based on the requirements
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions
• Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and quality standards
• Support continuous improvement and innovation initiatives
• Special projects as needed

Requirements:
• Experience in developing Java, Typescript, and Python
• Experience in relational database e.g., SQL Server, Postgres etc
• Ability to create and test REST APIs
• Writing clean and understandable code
• Knowledge of and ability to develop both front-end and backend applications
• Knowledge of and ability to work with both waterfall and agile methodologies
• Experience working with a team with a consistent focus on accountability, delivery, and customer experience
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Must be able to work independently with the key stakeholders in a courteous and professional manner
• Strong planning and organizing skills with attention to detail and accuracy
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• 1+ years of relevant experience
• Experience working as part of a product development team
• Proven ability to work in fast-paced, client-focused environments
• Position requires BS/BA degree in Computer Science or a STEM discipline from an accredited university with 1+ years of experience OR a MS/MA degree in STEM discipline with 1 year of experience
• U.S. Citizenship or permanent resident is required
• Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust Clearance

Preferred:
• Experience supporting federal programs preferred
